description: jest-canvas-mock as a setupFiles module on jest-environment-jsdom (T11.11): drawing calls on a 2d context, ctx.__getEvents() and __getDrawCalls() to toMatchSnapshot, and the context's jest.fn methods asserted on. The second file re-sets up in a beforeEach with jest.resetAllMocks() and setupJestCanvasMock(), the package's documented re-setup after a reset, in place of a project-wide resetMocks: true: the recorder's mockCleanup would set it for both files, and this keeps the first file under Jest's defaults while the second shows the re-setup. Runs with --ci=false, because under the recorder's CI Jest writes no new snapshot; the .snap files are captured. Two files on one worker.
